# SimpleMermaid

> SimpleMermaid is a free, browser-based editor for Mermaid.js diagrams. Write Mermaid code, see a live preview, share the diagram as a link (the diagram is stored in the URL), and export to PNG, SVG, PDF or Markdown. No signup; diagrams are processed locally in the browser.

## Product
- [Mermaid editor](https://simplemermaid.com/mermaid-tool.html): live preview, 64 ready-made templates, shareable links, export, light and dark themes
- [Features and templates](https://simplemermaid.com/features.html): all features and every template in one place

## Learn
- [Learn Mermaid syntax](https://simplemermaid.com/learn-mermaid.html): tutorial for flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt and more
- [Blog](https://simplemermaid.com/blog/): guides on diagram types, diagrams-as-code workflows, and Mermaid vs draw.io
- [FAQ](https://simplemermaid.com/faq.html): common questions about the editor, sharing, privacy and export
